description: Poly Mute: mutes individual channels of two polyphonic inputs, by button or by polyphonic gate

params.text: White passes that channel and red mutes it. A press toggles the channel, or inverts it only while held once a cable is patched into GATES. A button numbered above the output channel count is dimly lit
Off, muting and unmuting happen at once, which suits CV; on, they fade over 100ms, which keeps audio from popping
Sets what a high gate does: orange mutes that channel, green passes it, yellow flips its state on each rising edge

inputs.text: One gate per channel, read as Schmitt triggers going high at 2V and low at 0.2V, with missing channels counted as low. While it is patched it sets the state of every channel
A polyphonic signal to be muted channel by channel, carried to the output of the same number; a monophonic cable is copied to every channel. It is normalled to 10V, so unpatched it makes gates

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same number with every muted channel at 0V

menu: Polyphony channel count — Auto follows whichever input has more channels and gives 16 when neither is patched, or 1 to 16 fixes the count
